prompt:
Perform a thorough JWT security review of this FastAPI+Next.js authentication system. For each finding include: Severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), Location, Issue, and Fix.

CODE SUMMARY:

security.py:
- create_access_token: payload has sub,iss,aud,exp(15min),iat,jti(uuid4),type=access,ver=token_version
- decode_access_token: jwt.decode with audience+issuer validation
- generate_refresh_token: secrets.token_urlsafe(48)
- hash_refresh_token: SHA-256

auth.py endpoints:
- COOKIE_SECURE = not settings.DEBUG (False in dev)
- COOKIE_SAMESITE = lax
- access_token cookie has no path restriction; refresh_token cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth/refresh
- _client_ip: X-Forwarded-For.split(',')[0] with no validation
- _verify_origin: checks if Origin OR Referer starts with any ALLOWED_ORIGINS string
- POST /refresh: checks origin AFTER checking cookie; on any AuthError clears cookies
- POST /logout: all_sessions bool query param, unauthenticated callers can invoke
- GET /me: reads access_token cookie, decodes JWT, checks token_version vs DB

auth_service.py:
- refresh_tokens steps 8-9 (revoke old, create new) are NOT atomic - race condition window
- _check_lockout: datetime.now(utc) < user.locked_until.replace(tzinfo=utc) - only adds tzinfo, no convert
- _record_failed_attempt: no SELECT FOR UPDATE, increments in-memory then commits
- register_user: SELECT then INSERT with no race protection beyond DB unique constraint
- _create_refresh_session: DB commit then Redis set - Redis failure leaves orphaned DB session
- logout_user: no rate limiting

middleware.ts (Next.js):
- Uses jose jwtVerify
- CVE-2025-29927: x-middleware-subrequest header bypasses middleware entirely

lib/auth.ts:
- verifySession() is second layer defense in Server Components
- requireAuth() throws if null

List ALL security findings exhaustively.
